notes: First test build: the Figma plugin and the After Effects Receiver connect directly, with one-time approval.
Select frames to send just those, or select nothing to send every frame on the page.
Each frame becomes an AE composition with the right size, frame rate, duration and name, with Scale 1×–4× to enlarge comps.
Every top-level element arrives as its own Figma-rendered image, placed exactly where Figma draws it, with an optional Figma Reference layer on top.
Plain colour frame backgrounds arrive as editable solids.
Progress, Cancel, Resume after a disconnect, a results summary, and a saved report.
testFocus: First-time approval, then automatic reconnection after quitting and reopening After Effects.
Send 2–3 frames, then a batch of 20+; compare each comp against its Figma Reference layer.
Cancel halfway through a batch; quit After Effects during a send, then Resume.
Send the same frames twice: you should get new comps named “… 2”, never mixed-up ones.
